column2: 7.1 The Ayurvedic Health Care Centre shall provide the following types of Ayurvedic treatments.
Poorva Karma (Sneha an Sweda Karma, namely (a) Thaila Abyanga and Sheera Abyanga,
(b) Shirodhara, (c) Sarwangadhara, (d) Pinda and Wasshpa Swedha, (e) Agni and Niranga Swedha.
Pradhana Karma (Pancha Karma) namely (a) Vamana Karma, (b) Viredhana Karma, (c) Nasya
Karma, (d) Vasthi Karma, (e) Raktha Mokshana  Karma.
